name: rag
description: A portable retrieval pipeline: documents → structure-aware chunks → an embedded, serialisable index → cited top-k retrievals. The core is pure and provider-free (the embedder is injected); adapters add a security-defaulted repo/dir ingester, an AI SDK embedder, and a one-command CLI to point at a repo or knowledge base and get a queryable RAG.

env.name: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.desc: ai-embedder / cli only: credentials for the AI SDK embedding call. The core and the fs ingester read no env.

adapters.name: fs-ingest
adapters.desc: Walk a directory (repo/docs/KB) into Documents, skipping secrets, noise dirs, and binary/oversized files by default.

adapters.name: ai-embedder
adapters.desc: Wrap an AI SDK embedding model (gateway string or instance) as the core's Embedder. Requires the `ai` peer dep.

adapters.name: cli
adapters.desc: The one-command experience: `rag build <dir> --out kb.json` and `rag query kb.json "q"`. Pulls in fs-ingest + ai-embedder. Run with tsx. Requires the `ai` peer dep.
